description: LectureLens ASR evaluation set (PA.2). ~10 minutes of audio from one real lecture recording (third-party; see sourceRecording.note).

sourceRecording.note: A publicly available third-party lecture video (Gate Smashers: UML class diagrams), spoken in Hindi–English code-mixed speech, uploaded to a local LectureLens instance for testing. It is NOT one of the course's lectures and we have no consent from its lecturer beyond public availability: the audio is never committed or redistributed (clips/ is git-ignored). Identified by its opening line during the first real Groq run; earlier versions of this file wrongly called it a course lecture.

conditions.noisy: as recorded + synthetic pink noise at the stated SNR
conditions.accented: NONE YET — needs a recording of a speaker with a different accent; add one before reporting an accent comparison

clips.notes: Cut at a measured pause (ffmpeg silencedetect, -28 dB, 0.2 s). Condition is provisional: relabel if the typist hears background noise or music.
